indexes.name: idx_ability_create_operations_replay
indexes.predicate: idempotency_digest is not null and phase <> 'rejected'

tables.name: agent_retrievals
checks: session_attach is null or session_attach in ('declared', 'inferred')

tables.name: backup_generation_freeze
checks: (candidate_key_id is null and candidate_hash is null) or (candidate_key_id is not null and candidate_hash is not null)

tables.name: installation_generation
checks: (active_key_id is null and active_hash is null) or (active_key_id is not null and active_hash is not null)
(candidate_key_id is null and candidate_hash is null) or (candidate_key_id is not null and candidate_hash is not null)
phase <> 'active-installed' or (active_key_id is not null and candidate_key_id is null and candidate_hash is null)
phase = 'active-installed' or candidate_key_id is not null

tables.name: note_revisions
checks: document_format is null or document_format in ('markdown-v2', 'skill-markdown-v1', 'opaque-v1')
session_attach is null or session_attach in ('declared', 'inferred')

indexes.name: idx_note_revisions_agent_outside_created
indexes.predicate: session_id is null and agent_owner is not null
